tilapia.name: Tilapia
tilapia.description: Tilapia, also sold as Nile tilapia, is a freshwater fish.

sea_bass.name: Sea bass
sea_bass.description: Sea bass, also sold as European sea bass or branzino, is a marine fish.

mullet.name: Grey mullet
mullet.description: Grey mullet, known in Egypt as bouri, is a brackish-water fish.

grass_carp.name: Grass carp
grass_carp.description: Grass carp, known in Egypt as hashayesh, is a freshwater carp.

mubarakah.name: Common carp
mubarakah.description: Common carp, known in Egypt as qishra, is a fully scaled freshwater carp.

catfish.name: Catfish
catfish.description: Catfish, known in Egypt as karmout, is the African catfish, a freshwater fish.

lout.name: Meagre
lout.description: Meagre, known in Egypt as lout, is a marine fish.

thinlip_mullet.name: Thinlip mullet
thinlip_mullet.description: Thinlip mullet, known in Egypt as tobar, is a brackish-water mullet.

bayad_catfish.name: Bayad catfish
bayad_catfish.description: Bayad catfish is a freshwater catfish native to the Nile.

silver_carp.name: Silver carp
silver_carp.description: Silver carp is a freshwater carp.

mirror_carp.name: Mirror carp
mirror_carp.description: Mirror carp, known in Egypt as mabrouka, is a freshwater carp with only a few large scales.

sea_bream.name: Sea bream
sea_bream.description: Sea bream, also sold as gilthead sea bream or dorade, is a marine fish.

eels.name: European eel
eels.description: European eel is a brackish-water fish.
